reason: The repository describes a DSH web client plugin that adds a workspace dock in the left sidebar and uses workspace context to filter the main sidebar’s conversation list, with menu actions and visual status indicators for workspace sessions; this is best classified as a navigation UI enhancement.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在侧边栏左侧新增工作区 Dock，支持按工作区切换/过滤会话，并提供工作区菜单与名称和图标的管理。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that adds a workspace dock to the left sidebar, lets users switch and filter sessions by workspace, and provides workspace menu actions plus name/icon management.

capabilities: filter sessions by selected workspace in the main sidebar
display running/attention status badges for workspace sessions
open workspace context menu actions (open folder, copy path, rename, change icon, archive)
toggle dock between narrow and expanded modes
persist workspace icon/name settings in browser storage

reasons.code: README describes a sidebar left rail that renders one icon per workspace and filters the main sidebar when an icon is clicked.
README lists workspace menu actions and status badge behavior, indicating the plugin is primarily for workspace navigation and workspace/session management UX.
package.json declares a web client plugin with injected slots and workspace/session/locale context, consistent with UI extension behavior.
